description: This file defines the 'Run' class within the PhpSpreadsheet library, related to rich text handling. It extends TextElement and implements ITextElement, managing font styles for a text run.

classes.name: Run
classes.description: Represents a segment of rich text with specific font style, extending TextElement and handling font attributes.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new Run instance, optionally with existing text.

methods.name: getFont
methods.description: Returns the font object associated with this run.

methods.name: setFont
methods.description: Sets the font object for this run.

methods.name: getHashCode
methods.description: Generates a unique hash code based on text and font attributes.
